name: pdsh_03_06_concat_and_append
explanations: The DataFrame.append() method was removed in pandas 3.1.0. The notebook already uses pd.concat() in cells 7-15 for the same operation. Cell 16 tries to use the deprecated df1.append(df2) syntax which no longer exists. The fix replaces it with the equivalent pd.concat([df1, df2]) call.

name: pdsh_03_04_missing_values
